gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-mysuru: Loud, rounded display letters from Autour One, each curve entered by a clear channel. Hind Mysuru is plain sans through and through, its lowercase reaching almost to the ascender height, every a left slightly open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-inter-tight: Loud, rounded letters with no thin spots where a stroke meets a stem. Inter Tight stays quiet underneath, leaving Autour One to earn its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-liter: Autour One comes in bold, rounded, and expressive, hard to ignore. Liter, a sans-serif with no stroke contrast and wide-mouthed rounds, gives those showy curves a tall, steady partner underneath.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mada: Autour One bends constant-width strokes like pipe, with a clear channel into each round. And Mada, with its towering midzone, can stay at a modest size without losing presence.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-matangi: Matangi carries a hefty lowercase in sans-serif strokes like twine pressed flat, with its rounded letters left open. Autour One brings bold, expressive curves, so both feel sturdy and modern.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-montserrat-underlin: Expressive and bold, Autour One leads with round, channelled letters. Montserrat Underline, plain sans with breathing counters and lowercase that outsizes its capitals, supplies the real contrast against such a loud heading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Expressive Autour One makes its mark with a constant-width, laser-etched line, best at display sizes. But Noto Sans Bamum does the quiet work, its wide counters keeping small letters legible.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Thick, round, and unapologetic, with joins that never thin out. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, a sans-serif with coiled, swollen lowercase and open apertures, lets Autour One lead while staying readable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Autour One builds its round letters like rings, with a constant wall all the way around. And Noto Sans Brahmi, with its high mean line and open-ended curves, lightens the load beneath.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Fat, round, confident: Autour One never thins out where strokes meet. Noto Sans Buhid, plain sans with generous gaps at its curve ends and a high x-height, should read smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
